description: Regjeringen har identifisert et behov for et mer systematisk kunnskapsgrunnlag om utviklingen i det offentlige ordskiftet. For å følge opp føringene i Ytringsberedskap – Nasjonal strategi for eit ope og opplyst offentleg ordskifte, Strategi for å styrkje motstandskrafta mot desinformasjon og anbefalingene fra Ytringsfrihetskommisjonen, skal regjeringen etablere et forskningssenter som skal bidra med langsiktig forskning på det offentlige ordskiftet, inkludert statusen for ytringsfrihet, polarisering og desinformasjon. Senteret skal etter planen etableres for perioden 2026–2030. For budsjettåret 2025–2026 er det bevilget kr 5 mill. ekskl. mva. til en anskaffelse for etableringen av senteret. For årene 2027–2030 tar departementet sikte på en årlig ramme på kr 10 mill. ekskl. mva. for videre drift av senteret, med forbehold om Stortingets årlige budsjettbehandlinger. Anskaffelsens verdi er på kr 5 mill. ekskl. mva., men dersom Stortinget bevilger kr 10 mill. ekskl. mva. til videre drift av senteret i årene 2027–2030, vil kontraktens samlede verdi kunne bli kr 45 mill. ekskl. mva.

description: The rescEU Emergency Medical Teams (EMT) project is an initiative under the Union Civil Protection Mechanism aimed at strengthening Europe’s capacity to respond to medical emergencies. Eight countries — Belgium, France, Germany, Italy, Luxembourg, Portugal, Romania, and Türkiye — are collaborating to establish and maintain 21 specialised medical teams. The project runs from December 2022 to September 2026. Building on the experience of the European Modular Field Hospital (EUMFH) project, the goal is to ensure that all teams are equipped with interoperable and reliable equipment, enabling both joint operations and individual deployments. A key component of the project is the procurement of equipment and supporting infrastructure necessary to make the capacities operational. This includes not only medical equipment, but also a wide range of related items such as logistics, communication, and technical support systems. The procurement is carried out jointly by the participating countries, with the goal of ensuring harmonisation, cost-efficiency, and maximum interoperability. The procurement procedures are carried out on the Mercell Tendering Platform based on the Dynamic Purchaseing Procdure (DPS). Interested economic operators are invited to submitt their electronic applications for the relevant categories during the duration of the Dynamic Purchasing System. The contracting authority (Johanniter) may extend the duration of the Dynamic Purchasing System for 6 month. The full compliance with the procedure conditions is required. Questions e.g. about the conditions or participation have to be submitted by the economic operators exclusively in the section "Applicant Questions". Questions about the platform use have to be raised with a ticket under Mercell Support Page or by phone -+49 6131 6338918 . The Dynamic Purchasing System comprises 18 categories: 1. Tents, Mobile Shelters and Associated Equipment for Civil Protection and Emergency Response 2. Medical Equipment and Specialized Systems for Field Hospitals and Emergency Medical Response Units 3. Special Purpose Vehicles for Civil Protection and Field Operations 6. Logistics Equipment for Handling, Packaging, Storage and Field Transport, including Forklifts and Lifting Devices for Emergency Operations 7. Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) Equipment for Deployable Units and Emergency Response 8. Waste Management & Cleaning 9. WASH Supplies for Disaster Relief and Field Hospitals – Water Treatment, Sanitation, Hygiene 10. description: Dit betreft het DAS Externe Inzet voor de Coöperatieve Vereniging Loopbaan en Ontwikkeling U.A. (vanaf hier Leo Loopbaan genoemd). Leo Loopbaan is een projectorganisatie die in sommige gevallen (deels) wordt gefinancieerd met subsidies. In een aantal van die subsidieprojecten wordt Leo Loopbaan als een publiekrechtelijke dienst aangemerkt. Voor deze projecten geldt dat de aanbestedingsregels van toepassing zijn bij het inkopen van diensten en leveringen. Voor die projecten huurt Leo Loopbaan soms externe inzet in, dit zal dan gebeuren via dit DAS. Leo Loopbaan staat klaar voor iedereen in de provincie Limburg die bezig is met zijn of haar loopbaan. Of iemand nu net gestart is met een opleiding, werkzoekend of al geruime tijd aan het werk is. Leo Loopbaan biedt diensten aan op een laagdrempelige manier. Onafhankelijk, toegankelijk en bereikbaar. Leo Loopbaan inspireert en ondersteunt bij het bewust bezig zijn met Leven Lang Ontwikkelen (LLO) en loopbaan. De wereld om ons heen verandert snel en dat is niet anders voor de arbeidsmarkt. Daarom is het heel belangrijk om te blijven ontwikkelen. Leo Loopbaan maakt mensen bewust van hun mogelijkheden en motiveert mensen om zelf aan de slag te gaan. Daarnaast bouwt Leo Loopbaan aan een community waar kennis en (persoonlijke) loopbaangegevens bij elkaar komen. Deze community is zowel gericht op werkgevers, intermediaire structuren en mensen die toe zijn aan een stap in hun loopbaan. De leden van coöperatie zijn: Baandomein Connexio Gilde Opleidingen LWV Universiteit Maastricht VISTA college Yuverta Zorg aan Zet Zuyd Hogeschool De coöperatie wordt ondersteund door: Provincie Limburg UWV Limburg

The anticipated scope of work includes all labor, supervision, production, testing and quality assurance necessary to prepare for and accomplish the Preservation, Hull, Mechanical, and Electrical/Electronic Repairs. title: Strategic Contract Consolidation Announcement
description: Announcement of Contract Consolidation Strategy for Systems Engineering and Technical Assistance (SETA) and Fielding Support Agency: Department of Defense (DoD) / Department of the Army Program Office: CPE C2IN, multiple PMs Anticipated NAICS Code(s): 541330 (Engineering Services), 541611 (Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services), 541990 (All Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services) 1. Purpose and Intent The purpose of this Special Notice is to notify industry partners of an upcoming acquisition strategy realignment within the Command, Control, and Information Network (CPE C2IN) portfolio. To optimize mission delivery, eliminate functional redundancies, and drive operational efficiencies across all subordinate Project and Product Management offices, CPE C2IN is initiating a phased consolidation of portions of more than twenty (20) disparate legacy SETA and fielding contracts. These support requirements will be structured into three (3) distinct, enterprise-level contract vehicles: Business/Operations/Administrative Support Fielding, Property, Field Support, and Training Product Support This announcement is intended for planning purposes and early industry engagement. It does not constitute a Request for Proposals (RFP) or an invitation for bid. 2. Operational Background & Strategic Rationale Modern Command and Control (C2) modernization requires interoperability, agility, and synchronicity across multi-domain operational environments. Historically, individual program offices under CPE C2IN maintained dedicated, standalone SETA and service contracts. While effective for localized program execution, this decentralized model created operational silos and administrative friction. Modern C2 operations depend on a deeply integrated, layered architecture comprising: Infrastructure Layer: Physical and virtual compute, tactical hardware, command post shelters, platform integration, and power systems. Transport Layer: Line-of-sight, satellite, and tactical network transport capabilities ensuring high-throughput, survivable communications. Applications Layer: Common operating environment tools, mission command warfighting applications, and tactical service microservices. Data Layer: Unified data fabrics, tactical data management, ingestion, analytics, and security services. To ensure seamless support across this layered C2 architecture, cross-functional lifecycle support must transcend individual product boundaries. Consolidating baseline operational support functions ensures standardized practices, centralized oversight, improved resource allocation, and cohesive operational agility across all architecture layers. 3. Consolidated Support Portfolios (The Three Pillars) The scope of the transition involves migrating relevant portions of existing contracts into three core functional areas: Pillar I: Business/Operations/Administrative Support Scope: Human Resources (HR), Administration, Operations (Ops), Public Affairs Office (PAO), Business Management, Information Management, and related assistance Objective: Standardize administrative standard operating procedures (SOPs) and streamline business management operations across the organizational enterprise. Pillar II: Fielding, Property, Field Support, and Training Scope: provide an integrated Total Package fielding vehicle to plan, coordinate, execute, and sustain large-scale fielding of tactical command-and-control (C2) capabilities across geographically dispersed Army formations. CPE C2IN combined capabilities span the layered C2 architecture -infrastructure, transport, applications, and data which encompasses fielding management, technical and systems integration, vehicle installation, operator and maintainer training, field support engineering, logistics, transportation, inventory and property accountability, data and configuration management, and program-level execution. These organizations synchronize the delivery, integration, installation, configuration, testing, and acceptance of the infrastructure layer, transport layer, application layer, and data layer, ensuring the layers operate as an integrated capability rather than independent components. Objective: Maintain long-term system readiness, optimize sustainment expenditures, and unify product lifecycle management across the enterprise. 4. title: GROUP LES HEALTH INSURANCE UNDER GMC
description: Please note this solicitation is not ready to be issued as of this date. The Embassy of the United States in the Philippines will launch the solicitation on the SAM.gov website when it is available. This solicitation is to provide group health insurance services to employees of the Government of the United States of America in Manila, Philippines. The estimated numbers of employees and eligible dependents are included in the solicitation. This is a fixed price with economic price adjustment requirements type contract. The anticipated performance period is for a base year, with four one-year option periods, and one six-month option, if exercised by the Government. All responsible sources may submit an offer which will be considered. The Government may award the contract based on the initial offer without discussion. The resultant contract will be a fixed price with economic price adjustment requirements type of contract under which will be issued firm fixed price task orders, for one year with four one-year options, and six-month option, if exercised by the Government. The Government plans to issue the solicitation on or about March 2026. The proposal due date will be set forth in the solicitation. The Government is planning a pre-quotation conference and the date for this site visit and conference will be in the solicitation. All contractors shall be registered in the SAM (System for Award Management) Database https://sam.gov/content/home prior to submitting an offer pursuant to FAR provision 52.204-7. Therefore, prospective offerors are required to register prior to the submittal of proposals. The guidelines for registration in SAM are also available at: https://sam.gov/content/entity-registration Electronic Submission/Responses: This opportunity allows for electronic responses. Please submit your offer via email to ManilaContracting@state.gov prior to the response date and time. It is important to make sure the submission is made in specific size and format; in MS-Word 2007/2010 or MS-Excel 2007/2010 or Adobe Acrobat (pdf) file format. The file size must not exceed 10MB. If the file size should exceed 10MB, the submission must be made in separate files and attached to separate emails with less than 10MB each.
